sql: SELECT * FROM corpus_segments WHERE wylie LIKE ? ORDER BY course,seq

rows.acip: YANG KHA CIG NA RE, RNAG KHRAG LA SOGS PA'I DNGOS PO GSUM PO DE PHAN TSUN GO SA 'GOG PA'I DNGOS PO MA YIN PAR THAL, LAS CAN GYI 'GRO BA GSUM GYI CHU PHOR PA GANG LA CIG CAR DU BLTAS PA DE'I TSE NA, DNGOS PO TSAD GRUB PA GSUM SRID PAR KHAS BLANGS PA LA,
rows.wylie: yang kha cig na re, rnag khrag la sogs pa'i dngos po gsum po de phan tshun go sa 'gog pa'i dngos po ma yin par thal, las can gyi 'gro ba gsum gyi chu phor pa gang la cig car du bltas pa de'i tshe na, dngos po tshad grub pa gsum srid par khas blangs pa la
rows.english: Someone else may come now and make yet another argument: Let's talk about these three things: the pus and blood, and the other two. Are you implying then that these are not types of objects which would block each other from entering the space that each one occupies? After all, you were talking about a situation where those three types of beings, each with their own karma, sit down together and look at a glass full of water. And you said that your position was that it was possible for there to be three different objects there, each one confirmed by a valid perception.

rows.acip: DNGOS PO GSUM PHAN TSUN GO SA 'GOG PA'I DNGOS PO MA YIN PAR THAL BA'I RIGS PAS MI GNOD DE, DE'I TSE NA BRLAN ZHING GSHER BA PHOR PA GANG PO DE, DNGOS PO GSUM GYI GZHI MTHUN DU YANG KHAS MA BLANGS, TSAD MTSUNGS NGES PAR DGOS PAR YANG KHAS MA BLANGS PA'I PHYIR,
rows.wylie: dngos po gsum phan tshun go sa 'gog pa'i dngos po ma yin par thal ba'i rigs pas mi gnod de, de'i tshe na brlan zhing gsher ba phor pa gang po de, dngos po gsum gyi gzhi mthun du yang khas ma blangs, tshad mtshungs nges par dgos par yang khas ma blangs pa'i phyir
rows.english: This kind of reasoning, where you attempt to show that we are implying that the three objects are not the kinds that block each other from entering the space that each one occupies, cannot disprove our position. It is not our belief that in this situation the glass full of something which is wet and flowing is one thing which is three different things. Neither did we ever say that there definitely had to be identical valid perceptions here.
